title: Tomo TV diagnostics session
description: One playback as the engine recorded it, with the build and the machine that recorded it. Written by services/playbackProbe.ts to Caches/last-session.json on every event, and sent as the `session` of a version 2 outbox slot (services/diagnosticsOutbox.ts) to the user's Jellyfin display preferences. services/diagnosticsSchema.ts is the TypeScript shape and the parser; a version 1 document (two head strings, playback fields at the root) is lifted into this shape on read. The Diagnostics screen and every export (copy, share, mail) show this document with a `summary` object after `schemaVersion`; the summary is derived on display and never written to the file or the server. The exports also carry the playback in words as `summary.description`.

summary.description: Derived from `playback` when the document is shown or exported (services/diagnosticsLog.ts summarize). Absent from the stored file and the server slot.

item.description: The name the source event recorded, else the item id.

outcome.description: playback.outcome read together with motion: `playing` with no motion is `Never started`.

reachedSeconds.description: The last progress sample, to a tenth.

error.description: The last error's message when it decided the outcome.

retriedAfter.description: The last error's message when the player retried past it.

description.description: The playback in words (services/playbackStory.ts). Present in copy, share and mail; the screen shows it under the document instead.

app.description: The binary that recorded the session, which is not always the one reading it back.

build.description: CFBundleVersion. Empty when the build carried none.

name.description: A Mac running the iOS build reports iOS; device.family says Mac.

device.description: The machine. Every hardware field is null when it was not read: a version 1 document, or a build without the native module.

model.description: Apple's model identifier, uname machine on a device, hw.model on a Mac, SIMULATOR_MODEL_IDENTIFIER on a simulator.

marketingName.description: The name Apple sells the model under. Only Apple TV identifiers are named; a model this build does not know reads null and the screen shows the family and the identifier.

decode.description: What this device's VideoToolbox opens (native/ios/LocalRemuxer/DeviceDecode.swift). Null until the engine has asked.

h264MaxHeight.description: Tallest standard frame (1080, 2160, 4320) the hardware H.264 decoder opens; 0 for none.

hevcMaxHeight.description: Tallest standard frame the hardware HEVC decoder opens; 0 for none.

startedAt.description: Unix milliseconds when the player opened.

outcome.description: `playing` means no end was recorded: a viewer who backed out and a file that never started both read so. The screen separates them by motion (a `playing` event or a progress sample past zero).

events.description: In order of emission. Capped at 40: past that, events are dropped from just after the first 8, so the opening decisions and the latest activity both survive. Every string is redacted (utils/logger.ts redactSecrets), so a stream URL carries `ApiKey=[redacted]`.

progress.description: Position samples at most every 2 seconds, the last 10 kept.

lane.description: direct: the file as it is. localRemux: the on-device engine. transcode: the Jellyfin server converts. audio: the audio queue player.

event.description: One event. `t`, `event` and `itemId` are on every one; the rest is the payload the emitter recorded, which the Diagnostics screen prints under a band named after the event.

itemId.description: The item the session is for, the same on every event; the probe file the regression harness reads picks its lines by it.

start.description: The regression suite's arming marker, __DEV__ with probe=1 only. Carries nothing; the screen skips it.

mode.description: The lane picked for this playback (hooks/useVideoPlayback.ts, services/audioPlayerManager.ts). A second mode event is a lane change.

canDirectPlay.description: The player opens the file as it stands.

burnIn.description: A subtitle track is burnt in by the server.

held.description: Played from this device's downloads; no server involved.

source.description: What Jellyfin says the file is (playbackProbe.ts sourceSummary). The block that answers "why will my file not play" without the file.

stream.description: The URL handed to the player. Query secrets are redacted; a `file:` URL is a download.

playing.description: The moment playback first moved, once per session.

afterSeconds.description: Seconds from the player opening, to a tenth.

ended.description: Playback reached the end. Sets outcome to `ended`.

natural.description: Audio queue only: the track ran out rather than being skipped.

error.description: A player or metadata failure. Sets outcome to `error` unless `willRetry`: an error the player retries is a detour, and the playback after it decides the outcome.

mode.description: The lane, or `metadata` when the item could not be fetched.

index.description: Audio queue only: the track that failed.

fallback.description: The lane moved without a new mode event: the engine fell below realtime, failed to start, or a direct stream stalled silently.

to.description: `remux-or-transcode` means the lane is re-picked; the mode event that follows says which.

decline.description: The on-device engine declined the file (services/localRemux.ts canRemuxLocally, or a remembered below-realtime verdict in useVideoPlayback.ts).

examples: engine below realtime on an earlier play

codecs.description: Every audio codec, comma separated, when none was carriable.

at.description: When the remembered verdict was recorded.

enginePlan.description: What the engine decided per stream, once per engine session (services/localRemux.ts EnginePlan). `video` is absent for an audio-only session.

preflight.description: The engine timed its opening segment before the player was bound (useVideoPlayback.ts). `remembered` says the verdict was stored for this file; `keptForTier` says a slow engine was kept because a server tier carries the open; `failed` carries the engine's own message when the session died before a segment.

produceSeconds.description: Wall seconds to produce the segment; null when nothing arrived before the deadline.

failed.description: The engine's failure message (Remuxer.fail), e.g. "open_input: Server returned 404 Not Found". Absent when the deadline passed with the session alive.

tier.description: The server rung declared beside the engine's full-quality feed (memories/CLAUDE-slipstream.md).

probeSeconds.description: How long the opening segment took to fetch and rewrap.

variant.description: The HLS variant the engine declared to AVPlayer.

tierFirst.description: A server rung is listed first, so the player opens on it.

engineRestart.description: The engine session was restarted in place.

position.description: Seconds carried into the new session.

qualitySwitch.description: The viewer or the adaptive ladder moved to another quality preset.

other.description: Any event name this schema does not list. The screen prints its payload the same way, so a new emit site needs no schema change to be shown, only to be documented.

trackPlan.description: One stream as the engine handles it (services/localRemux.ts EngineTrackPlan).

rendition.description: Audio only: `primary` or the alternate rendition prefix (`a0`, `a1`).

encoder.description: FFmpeg's name for the encoder that opened; absent on a copy.

streamPlan.description: Every field past `codec` is present only when the codec parameters carry it.
